title: Kīlauea Volcano — Fissure 8 Video Compilation
place: Fissure 8, Leilani Estates, Kīlauea lower East Rift Zone, Hawaiʻi
audio: natural roar (kept AAC) - not listened to closely
notes: SPARE. Ground view across a black lava field: a red lava fountain (x~0.45-0.6,y~0.35-0.85) pulses up against grey clouds, secondary spatter to its right; utility pole at far right (x~0.97). Small USGS bug bottom-left (x~0.0-0.07,y~0.96). Continuous fountaining, height pulses. Best shot A 0.0-2.6; shot B 6.0-8.6.
fact_en: Fountain heights exceeded 200 feet and secondary fountains reached heights of 60 feet.
